D06 A15 A17 two local repair rounds preserve preview semantics; third round and failed plans cannot apply
D06 A19 native subprocess runs offline without model/MCP and reports errors with nonzero exit
criteria.result: Same-authorized plan/preview/apply/deliver completes without extra confirmation or network/model credentials in a native subprocess. Unknown styles exit nonzero; infeasible plans have no transaction. Visual/Office remain unverified. Actual HTML ArtifactIdentity is audited and stale source/history reports are rejected.

limitations: Visual aesthetic review and Office real-open/edit/resave are unverified; generating representative PNGs does not assert human visual approval.
New design planning accepts only pristine new projects; human-edited decks use existing scoped protected planners. Capacity failures remain explicit proposals, never automatic content deletion.
The host Agent owns the two-round workflow counter; CLI rejects round values beyond two and receipts record repair evidence. It is not a daemon or a second model.
D06 exercises the built native CLI in a credential-free, network-disabled subprocess; the existing C06 suite separately verifies actual tarball installation and legacy offline workflows.
